# merge

<link-summary>Fills the `{{ key }}` placeholders of a template from an object.</link-summary>

<web-summary>merge() — Fills the `{{ key }}` placeholders of a template from an object. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function merge(template: string, data: object, options: MergeOptions = {}): string;
```

Whitespace inside the braces is ignored, so `{{name}}` and `{{ name }}` are the same placeholder. A key that the object does not carry is left as it stands, which makes a missing value visible rather than silently blank; `onMissing: "empty"` removes it instead.

`escape` takes a function applied to every substituted value — pass `escapeHtml` when the result goes into a page.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type           | Description                                                                         |
| :---------------------------- | :------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `template`                    | `string`       | The template string with `{{ key }}` placeholders.                                  |
| `data`                        | `object`       | The object the values come from.                                                    |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `MergeOptions` | `onMissing` is `"keep"` or `"empty"`; `escape` is a function applied to each value. |

## Returns

`string` — the template with its placeholders filled.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                                                   |
| :------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the template is not a string, or the data is not an object. |

## Examples

### Filling a template

```javascript
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", { name: "Ada" }); // => "Hi Ada!"
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", {}); // => "Hi {{ name }}!"
merge("Hi {{ name }}!", {}, { onMissing: "empty" }); // => "Hi !"
```
